title: EVALUATING APPROACHES TO IDENTIFYING RESEARCH SUPPORTING THE UNITED NATIONS SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT GOALS

bias_targets.methodology: Benchmarking various Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) keyword queries and machine learning models across multiple independently hand-labeled datasets to demonstrate that poor overlap and performance discrepancies are caused by the intrinsic interpretational biases of query developers and human annotators.

Analyzing the geographic limitations of validation datasets (e.g., datasets relying exclusively on Western European or Chilean researchers) and evaluating how localized keyword additions (e.g., specific terms relevant to New Zealand) perform against global queries.
Documenting limitations in survey-based validation sets where ground-truth labels are generated by researchers who self-assess their own papers or have incentives to cite their own research.
